claims.text: Many reviewers say the backs effectively support and lift heavy earrings, keeping them from drooping or stretching the piercing.
Several reviewers report the backs do not fit or work with many of their post earrings, especially posts with ridges, and some found them finicky or awkward to use.
Reviewers praise the quality and finish, with some noting the plated backs did not irritate their sensitive ears.
Some reviewers find the backs easy to put on and appreciate the adjustable design for different earring sizes and weights.
Reviewers with low or stretched piercings say the backs let them wear heavy studs again without losing them.
